text: Professional Overview: This major features the integration of science and technology, covering disciplines such as physical electronics, microelectronics and solid-state electronics, circuits and systems, electromagnetic fields and microwave technology, etc. It mainly focuses on the design, manufacturing, performance analysis of electronic devices, integrated circuits, and optoelectronic devices, as well as the development and application of electronic systems.Training Objectives: To cultivate students who are all-round in terms of morality, intelligence, physical fitness, aesthetics, and labor skills, possessing the necessary natural science foundation, systematic professional knowledge, and strong experimental skills and engineering practice abilities. They should also have good foreign language proficiency, innovative consciousness, and the ability to keep up with and master new theories, knowledge, and technologies in this field. They can engage in related technical and management work in areas such as semiconductor manufacturing and optoelectronic integration applications.
